author: aobolensk
title: Conformance (API) Pack Artifacts fails - tar file changed as we read it
signature: tar file changed as we read it|Configuration

failed_jobs.name: Conformance (API)
failed_jobs.symptom: Pack Conformance Artifacts step exits with code 1 due to tar archiving its own output file

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status check failed because Conformance (API) failed

key_errors: tar: conformance_artifacts.tar.gz: file changed as we read it
ERROR:xml_merge_tool:/__w/openvino/openvino/install/conformance_artifacts/report/parallel/report_api_6272_1786408085923835095.xml is incorrect! Error to get a xml root
root_cause: The 'Pack Conformance Artifacts' step runs 'tar -cvf - * | pigz > conformance_artifacts.tar.gz' from within the CONFORMANCE_ARTIFACTS_DIR. Because the output file conformance_artifacts.tar.gz is created inside the same directory being archived, tar detects the file changed while it was reading it, causing a non-zero exit code. This is a well-known tar self-reference anti-pattern. An additional non-critical warning arises from an XML file with an invalid root that the xml_merge_tool logs as an error but does not block. The PR changes (Snippets buffer adjacency optimization) are unrelated to this CI configuration issue.
reproduction_steps: Run: pushd CONFORMANCE_ARTIFACTS_DIR && tar -cvf - * | pigz > conformance_artifacts.tar.gz; tar will warn 'file changed as we read it' and exit with code 1 because the output file is inside the archived directory.
recommended_actions: Fix the tar command to write the output outside the source directory, e.g.: tar -cvf - -C ${CONFORMANCE_ARTIFACTS_DIR} . | pigz > /tmp/conformance_artifacts.tar.gz && mv /tmp/conformance_artifacts.tar.gz ${CONFORMANCE_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/
Alternatively, exclude the output file: tar --exclude=conformance_artifacts.tar.gz -cvf - * | pigz > conformance_artifacts.tar.gz
Re-add PR #37080 to the merge queue as the failure is unrelated to its changes
prevention_strategies: In CI workflow steps that archive a directory, always write the archive output to a path outside the source directory, or use --exclude to skip the output file. Add a CI linter check for tar commands that write into their own source directory.
historical_context: Same signature was observed on 2026-07-28 in run 30356512752 (Conformance OP job). This is the second occurrence.
